medicare_levy.scope: Australian resident individual for the full income year, single with no spouse or dependants at any time in the year, not entitled to the seniors and pensioners tax offset, and not entitled to any full or half Medicare levy exemption. The operator must also establish whether s 9A applies: from 2024-25 it takes eligible lump sums in arrears out of taxable income when they are at least 10% of normal taxable income and its accrual-year tests are met. A person to whom s 9A applies is refused. Supply established whole-dollar taxable income. Applies the 2% rate and the low-income reduction: no levy at or below the threshold amount, and up to the phase-in limit no more than 10% of the excess over it. Excludes the family income reduction, SAPTO thresholds, exemptions, the Medicare levy surcharge, trustees and part-year residence.

low_income_tax_offset.scope: Individual who was an Australian resident at some time in the income year, not a trustee, and not a minor whose offset s 61-115(2) caps because Division 6AA of Part III of the 1936 Act applies to part of their income. Supply established whole-dollar taxable income. Gives the offset amount under ITAA 1997 s 61-115(1): $700 to $37,500, less 5% of the excess to $45,000, then $325 less 1.5% of the excess, nil above $66,667. The 1.5% band can leave half a cent, rounded half up. The offset is non-refundable; this worksheet does not apply it against tax payable or combine it with other offsets.

ok.scope: One regular weekly, fortnightly or monthly payment of salary or wages made from 1 July 2026 to a payee who gave a TFN declaration or withholding declaration saying they have a study and training support loan debt, on scale 1, 2, 3, 5 or 6 as the operator established. study_loan_repayment.scope: One individual's compulsory study and training support loan repayment for an income year from 2025-26, at the marginal rates the ATO publishes, from established whole-dollar repayment income: taxable income excluding assessable FHSS released amounts, plus reportable fringe benefits, total net investment loss, reportable super contributions and exempt foreign employment income, which the operator establishes. study_loan_withholding.scope: One regular weekly, fortnightly or monthly payment of salary or wages made from 1 July 2026 to a payee who gave a TFN declaration or withholding declaration saying they have a study and training support loan debt, on scale 1, 2, 3, 5 or 6 as the operator established. Scale 1 uses the Schedule 8 component for a payee who did not claim the tax-free threshold; scales 2, 3, 5 and 6 use the one for a payee who claimed it or is a foreign resident. Excludes scale 4, a Medicare levy variation for a spouse or dependants, tax offsets, extra amounts for 53 or 27 pays, quarterly pays, lump sum termination payments, back payments, bonuses and other schedules.

medicare_levy.scope: Australian resident individual for the full income year, single with no spouse or dependants at any time in the year, not entitled to the seniors and pensioners tax offset, and not entitled to any full or half Medicare levy exemption. The operator must also establish whether s 9A applies: from 2024-25 it takes eligible lump sums in arrears out of taxable income when they are at least 10% of normal taxable income and its accrual-year tests are met. A person to whom s 9A applies is refused. Supply established whole-dollar taxable income. Applies the 2% rate and the low-income reduction: no levy at or below the threshold amount, and up to the phase-in limit no more than 10% of the excess over it. Excludes the family income reduction, SAPTO thresholds, exemptions, the Medicare levy surcharge, trustees and part-year residence.

low_income_tax_offset.scope: Individual who was an Australian resident at some time in the income year, not a trustee, and not a minor whose offset s 61-115(2) caps because Division 6AA of Part III of the 1936 Act applies to part of their income. Supply established whole-dollar taxable income. Gives the offset amount under ITAA 1997 s 61-115(1): $700 to $37,500, less 5% of the excess to $45,000, then $325 less 1.5% of the excess, nil above $66,667. The 1.5% band can leave half a cent, rounded half up. The offset is non-refundable; this worksheet does not apply it against tax payable or combine it with other offsets.

division_293.scope: One individual's Division 293 tax for an income year from established Division 293 income (income for surcharge purposes disregarding reportable super contributions) and low tax contributions for the corresponding financial year (low tax contributed amounts less excess concessional contributions).
